messages.author: 4a5c80989676d9e2
messages.subject: DIF function runs for infinity
parts:
I am trying to run a DIF analysis on multidimensional nominal data.
I am using the guide written by Adam Meade - he wrote the guide on Likert data with one dimension, but I'm trying to adapt it to my problem.

When I'm running the DIF function, the function runs for infinity - I left it to run all night and nothing happened in the morning.

I first run the multipleGroup function to create a baseline model:

model.constrained <- multipleGroup(data, 3, group,
                                  invariance = c(colnames(data), 'free_means', 'free_var'))

This one runs for 500 iterations and then shows the warning: "EM cycles terminated after 500 iterations." but the object is still created so I used it in the DIF function.
I run the DIF function like this:

dif.drop <- DIF(model.constrained, c('a1','a2','a3','d1','d2','d3'), scheme = 'drop',
                seq_stat = .05)

And it runs for infinity times. I tried playing with the max_run parameter of the function but it doesn't help.

Anyone have any suggestions on what's the problem and what I can do to solve it?

Thanks!
